2608.21315.title: Prompt-Model Interaction Reaches the Fixed Points: A deterministic, task-free structural readout -- and the factorizations of it that failed
2608.21315.paper_summary: That a prompt's effect is not a property of the prompt is established: prompts optimised for one model degrade on another, and rankings reorder under neutral reformatting. That evidence is about task accuracy, which cannot say whether the interaction is a fact about task machinery or about the conditional distribution itself. We ask on a readout with no task in it: the fixed-point structure of the short-window argmax map x_{t+1} = argmax_x p(x | x_{t-1}, x_t), censused from 96 starts. It is deterministic, so nothing can be helped or hurt, and it exists only at short windows -- four of six models lose it entirely by window 16 -- so everything here concerns how a model reads a fragment. Two results. First, the interaction reaches this readout at full magnitude: nine tokens of conditioning move the fixed-point fraction across most of its range, change a four-way structural class, and reorder models, while instruction tuning worth 60.5 IFEval points moves the class by zero. Second, nothing we proposed carries it. Prefix length fails: the effect is not monotone. Four phenomenological factors -- prose-versus-markup, a universal direction, bidirectionality, instruct-resistance -- were each withdrawn within one run of being proposed, dissolved by widening the sample. And the nearest mechanistic account, attention-sink dominance of early tokens, predicts the sign of the shift on 2 of 5 models -- chance -- while a length-by-content cross shows it holds on real text and fails on our probe's uniformly random input, so we are outside its regime, not against it. One fixed nine-token prefix drives four models toward 0 and two toward 1; the bidirectionality survives in-distribution starts. On this readout the unit of explanation is the prompt-model pair. The recurring error it caught in us has a name: a criterion with a shape applied to a quantity with no room to vary.
2608.21315.paper_summary_zh: 已經確立了一個提示的效果並不是提示本身的屬性：針對一個模型優化的提示在另一個模型上會下降，並且在中性重新格式化下，排名會重新排序。該證據與任務準確性有關，無法判斷互動是關於任務機制的事實還是關於條件分佈本身的事實。我們在沒有任務的讀出中提出問題：短窗口 argmax 地圖的固定點結構 x_{t+1} = argmax_x p(x | x_{t-1}, x_t)，從 96 次啟動中進行普查。它是確定性的，因此無法幫助或傷害，並且僅存在於短窗口中——六個模型中的四個在窗口 16 時完全失去它——因此這裡的一切都與模型如何讀取片段有關。兩個結果。首先，互動以全幅度達到這個讀出：九個條件的標記使固定點分數跨越其大部分範圍，改變一個四向結構類別，並重新排序模型，而價值 60.5 IFEval 點的指令調整則使類別變化為零。其次，沒有我們提出的任何東西能夠承載它。前綴長度失敗：這個效果不是單調的。四個現象學因素——散文與標記、普遍方向、雙向性、指令抗性——在被提出的一次運行內都被撤回，並通過擴大樣本而解散。而最近的機制解釋，早期標記的注意力沉沒主導，預測了 5 個模型中 2 個的變化方向——偶然——而長度與內容的交叉顯示它在真實文本上成立，並在我們探測的均勻隨機輸入上失敗，因此我們處於它的範疇之外，而不是對抗它。一個固定的九標記前綴將四個模型推向 0，兩個模型推向 1；雙向性在分佈內的啟動中存活。在這個讀出中，解釋的單位是提示-模型對。它在我們身上捕捉到的反覆錯誤有一個名字：一個形狀應用於一個沒有變化空間的數量的標準。
2608.21315.author: Nicolás Vera Zúñiga et.al.
